title: 버스 도착 안내판 읽기: 몇 분 후에 와요? 몇 번째 전이에요?

review: words '번째 전' 예문: '내 버스는 지금 2번째 전이에요.'의 '내 버스'는 영어 'my bus'를 그대로 옮긴 말투라 한국어로는 부자연스럽고, 해요체와도 어울리지 않음. '제가 탈 버스는 지금 2번째 전이에요.'로 고치고, 번역도 'The bus I'm taking is two stops away now.'에 맞출 것.
words '도착': 뜻풀이는 'arrival (at this stop)'인데 예문 '기차가 10분 늦게 도착했어요.'는 정류장이 아니라 기차 도착이라 서로 맞지 않음. 예문을 '버스가 정류장에 도착했어요. (The bus arrived at the stop.)'처럼 바꾸거나, 뜻풀이를 'arrival'로 넓힐 것.

passage[1] (the bus display in the story): the five buses are written in one line with no separator. It reads '…— 곧 도착 520번 (시청역 방면) — 2분 후 도착 [전 정류장 출발] 305번 …', so learners can take '곧 도착' as part of bus 520's line, or '[전 정류장 출발]' as part of bus 305's line. Questions 1, 2 and 4 depend on reading this display. The new display in question 6 already separates buses with ' / ', so the two are also inconsistent. Fix: put a line break or ' / ' after each bus, e.g. '[버스 도착 안내] 101번 (시청역 방면) — 곧 도착 / 520번 (시청역 방면) — 2분 후 도착 [전 정류장 출발] / 305번 (한국대학교 방면) — 7분 후 도착 [3번째 전] / 62번 (한국대학교 방면) — 출발 대기 / N30번 (시청역 방면) — 운행 종료'.

fixes.before: Learners can read a Korean bus arrival display. For any bus, they can find where it is going (○○ 방면), how many minutes until it arrives (○분 후 도착, 곧 도착), how many stops away it is (○번째 전, 전 정류장 출발), and what the status labels 출발 대기 and 운행 종료 mean. They can then decide which bus to take.
fixes.after: Learners can read a Korean bus arrival display (direction, arrival time, stops away, status such as 출발 대기 and 운행 종료) and use it to choose a bus.

fixes.before: Anna is waiting at the bus stop near her home and needs to get to class at 10:00. She reads the bus arrival display to find the right bus. She checks where each bus is going, how many minutes away it is, and how many stops away it is. She also learns what 출발 대기 and 운행 종료 mean, and then she decides which bus to wait for. Afterward, learners read the display from the story and a new one and choose a bus themselves.

fixes.problem: "sangat segera" is unnatural Indonesian for "very soon".
"Bus yang saya naiki" means the bus the speaker is already riding, which contradicts it being two stops away. The English means the bus the speaker is going to take.
fixes.fix: Bus yang akan saya naiki sekarang tinggal dua halte lagi.

fixes.problem: "rất sắp đến" is unnatural Vietnamese because "sắp" doesn't normally take the intensifier "rất". Use "sắp đến ngay" to say "very soon".
fixes.fix: sắp đến ngay, gần đến rồi

fixes.problem: "está chegando bem agora" means 'arriving right now', not 'coming very soon'; meaning shifted.
fixes.fix: Espere um momento, o ônibus já está quase chegando.

fixes.problem: Ungrammatical: distance expression requires the preposition 'a' ("a quantas paradas ele está").
fixes.fix: Observe o painel da história. Quantos minutos faltam para o ônibus 305 chegar, e a quantas paradas ele está agora? Responda em coreano.

fixes.problem: "거의 다 와서" ends in the connecting ending -아서, so it reads as an unfinished clause and is unnatural as a gloss for "almost here".
'Beginner (high)' means the upper part of the beginner level. '初级(高级)' reads as 'beginner (advanced)', which contradicts itself and uses 高级, the term for the advanced level.
